text:
You will be called silence from now on.

And the place you occupied in the air

will be called melancholy.


I will write a name in the red wine:

your name that was beside my soul,

smiling among violets.


Now I look for a long time, absorbed,

at this hand that moved across your face,

that dreamed beside you.


This distant hand, from another world,

that knew one rose and another rose,

and the warm, the slow mother-of-pearl.


One day I will go looking for myself, I will go seeking

my thirsty ghost among the pines

and the word love.


You will be called silence from now on.

I write it with the hand that on that day

went with you among the pines.

translation.title: It Is Melancholy
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the renaming of absence as silence and melancholy, and the hand as witness.
